text: PACKAGE_GO: cleanup of benchmark-created profile/address/route is sufficient; do not modify pre-existing DHCP profiles to force an earlier transient disconnected state. Capture current autoconnect/DHCP state and unchanged default route, document that NM resumed its existing profile, and proceed with archive/upload. Primary has the same normal automatic retry. We will verify temporary additions absent and leave original profiles untouched. Please include counter-delta source paths and inventory in the archive.
